query:
INSERT INTO tournament_registrations (tournament_id, battlesnake_id, user_id, seed)
        SELECT $1::uuid, b.battlesnake_id, $3::uuid, $4::int
        FROM battlesnakes b
        WHERE b.battlesnake_id = $2
          AND b.deleted_at IS NULL
        FOR SHARE
        RETURNING
            registration_id,
            tournament_id,
            battlesnake_id,
            user_id,
            seed,
            registered_at
